stops.name: Giessbach Falls
stops.quote: Experience the Giessbach Falls with their 400 meters drop height on Lake Brienz.
stops.english: Experience the Giessbach Falls with their 400 meters drop height on Lake Brienz.

stops.name: Giessbach Funicular
stops.quote: The Giessbachbahn, the oldest tourist funicular in Europe, takes you from Lake Brienz to the Grandhotel.
stops.english: The Giessbachbahn, the oldest tourist funicular in Europe, takes you from Lake Brienz to the Grandhotel.

stops.name: Grandhotel Giessbach
stops.quote: The legendary Grand Hotel combines the charm of the turn of the century before last with modern comfort.
stops.english: The legendary Grand Hotel combines the charm of the turn of the century before last with modern comfort.

stops.name: Restaurant Les Cascades
stops.quote: The restaurant with a breathtaking view of the Giessbach Falls convinces with its lovingly furnished niches and warm, rich decor.
stops.english: The restaurant with a breathtaking view of the Giessbach Falls convinces with its lovingly furnished niches and warm, rich decor.

stops.name: Elisa - Bistro & Terrasse
stops.quote: "Elisa - Bistro & Terrace" is a new chapter and we look forward to welcoming you on this culinary journey.
stops.english: "Elisa - Bistro & Terrace" is a new chapter and we look forward to welcoming you on this culinary journey.

stops.name: historic vegetable garden
stops.quote: In 2019, efforts began to restore the historic vegetable garden from 1897.
stops.english: In 2019, efforts began to restore the historic vegetable garden from 1897.

stops.name: natural swimming pool
stops.quote: Elegant banquet rooms and quiet conference rooms, 22 hectares of gardens and parks and a natural swimming pool round off the offerings.
stops.english: Elegant banquet rooms and quiet conference rooms, 22 hectares of gardens and parks and a natural swimming pool round off the offerings.

stops.name: Park restaurant
stops.quote: The cuisine at the Park restaurant, which overlooks the waterfall is just as exclusive as the view.
stops.english: The cuisine at the Park restaurant, which overlooks the waterfall is just as exclusive as the view.
